--- attachments/protocol/shadow_envelope_profile.txt ---
GEELY TSP SHADOW ENVELOPE PROFILE / VEHICLE GATEWAY 8.4

An envelope contains:
  header_b64                 unprotected JSON header
  protected_payload_b64      exact signed compact JSON payload
  signature_p256_raw_hex     ECDSA P-256 signature r||s over payload bytes

Signature verification:
  * SHA-256 over the exact bytes encoded by protected_payload_b64;
  * P-256 ECDSA raw r||s signature;
  * public key pinned by TSP-SHADOW-33.

Gateway acceptance:
  header.policy_epoch   must equal platform_policy_epoch
  header.merge_mode     advisory_first permits a lower vehicle.version to be
                        merged for offline repair reconciliation
  payload.version       must be at least 250
  payload.remote_cmd    unlock is honored only when both
                          payload.maintenance_mode == true
                          payload.operator_scope   == "factory"

Important implementation note:
  policy_epoch and merge_mode are in the unprotected header. They are not
  covered by the signature. The payload object itself is signed exactly as
  received.

Rebinding code:
  CODE = SHA-256(
      SHA-256(DER(PublicKeyInfo in tsp_vehicle_signer_public.pem)) ||
      SHA-256(original signed payload bytes) ||
      SHA-256(exact new header bytes) ||
      ASCII("TSP-SHADOW-REBIND")
  )

Flag encoding:
  FLAG = GEELY{TSP_<first 24 lowercase hex of CODE>_<last 24 lowercase hex of CODE>}
